verdict.rationale: Docs confirm individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training (github-copilot-docs-12), but this is narrower than full telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out; a community report from an early preview noted mandatory 'additional telemetry terms' with no opt-out (github-copilot-comm-5), suggesting telemetry itself isn't fully controllable. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of a general telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting (beyond training-data opt-out), and independent confirmation that telemetry can be disabled in current production versions.
